articles.title: Kazakhstan votes in a parliamentary election expected to strengthen president’s grip on power - AP News
articles.description: Kazakhstan voted Sunday in a parliamentary election that is expected to further strengthen President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev’s grip on power in Central Asia’s largest nation. The pro-presidential Adilet party is predicted to win a majority in Sunday's election …
